)

)

    , actor_id TEXT REFERENCES local_principals(id))

CREATE TABLE local_customers (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, phone TEXT,

)

CREATE TABLE local_goods_receipt_lines (

  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_products(id),
  quantity_milli INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_milli > 0),

  unit_cost_paise INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_paise BETWEEN 0 AND 9000000000000),

  PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id, line_index)
)

CREATE TABLE local_goods_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_purchase_orders(id),
  supplier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_suppliers(id),
  reference TEXT,
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  goods_total_paise INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(goods_total_paise BETWEEN 0 AND 9000000000000),
  damaged_total_paise INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(damaged_total_paise BETWEEN 0 AND 9000000000000),

  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)

CREATE TABLE local_held_bills (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('held','active','checkout','completed','discarded')),

    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_request TEXT NOT NULL,

    checkout_request TEXT,

    CHECK((checkout_id IS NULL) = (checkout_request IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE local_hub_devices(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, credential_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, generation TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('pending','approved','revoked')), actor_id TEXT REFERENCES local_principals(id), created INTEGER NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_seen INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE local_hub_operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_hub_devices(id), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_principals(id), generation TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE local_hub_sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_hub_devices(id), device_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_principals(id), actor_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE local_identity (

 business_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

 origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('new','legacy'))
)

CREATE TABLE local_identity_audit (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 business_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,

 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)

        operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

        request TEXT NOT NULL,
        result TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
    )
CREATE TABLE local_inventory_outbox(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES local_inventory_events(operation_id),payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE local_inventory_pending(actor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES local_principals(id),operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES local_inventory_events(operation_id))

CREATE TABLE local_invoice_stock (

)

)

    )

)

  sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

)
